description: A performance metronome with an accented first beat, subdivisions, tap tempo and three sound textures. Timing runs on the audio thread.

controls.action: Open Menu for Guide, audio routing, Reload or Exit.
Tap repeatedly to set tempo. Taps also realign the beat.
Reset the beat position and tap history without resetting tempo or other parameters.

sections.title: Touch and audio
sections.text: On-screen tempo, Beats, Split, Sound, Start/Stop, Tap and Reset controls perform the same actions. Route sound and adjust its output level in Menu. In Preview, enable Listen to preview before starting.

sections.title: Saved settings
sections.text: Tempo, beats, subdivision and timbre are saved automatically. Reopening retains these values and starts stopped.
